raw_text: A potential breakdown in the NSCN-IM ceasefire agreement has triggered widespread unrest in Nagaland, with tribal organizations calling for a total shutdown across multiple districts. The protest coordination, detected by OSINT monitoring through encrypted Telegram channels six hours before the first mainstream report, included detailed road blockade locations and community mobilization instructions.
clean_text: NSCN-IM ceasefire breakdown triggered widespread unrest in Nagaland with total shutdown. OSINT detected encrypted Telegram coordination six hours before mainstream reports with detailed blockade logistics.
